entries.title: ahrefs@1.0.0: feat(plugins): add Ahrefs MCP plugin (#9674)
entries.note: feat(plugins): add Ahrefs MCP plugin Ahrefs hosts a remote MCP server at https://api.ahrefs.com/mcp/mcp with OAuth (dynamic client registration, PKCE, scope apiv3-mcp). Add it as a first-party plugin with an ahrefs_mcp connector. Ahrefs exposes no account or user id in its token response or API, so the connector keys the connection on the granted scope: one Ahrefs connection per user per organization. Ahrefs issues no refresh token; access tokens last a year. fix(plugins): key Ahrefs identity on token_type RFC 6749 lets a token endpoint omit scope but requires token_type, so a missing scope can no longer fail every connect. Document that a user can connect one Ahrefs workspace at a time. Co-authored-by: Harshith Mullapudi 17528887+harshithmullapudi@users.noreply.github.com
